movelist.name: Fire Fang
movelist.effect: Fire Fang Burns or Flinches on 18-19 during Accuracy Check; flip a coin to determine whether the foe gets Burned or Flinches. On 20 during Accuracy Check, the foe is Burned and Flinches.

movelist.name: Swagger
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. Swagger Confuses the target.

movelist.name: Stomp
movelist.effect: Stomp Flinches the target on 15+. If the target is at least one size category smaller than the user, Stomp deals an additional 10 damage.

movelist.name: Fire Spin
movelist.effect: The target is put in a Vortex.

movelist.name: Roar
movelist.effect: When declaring Roar, the user does nothing and may not Shift. At the end of the round, the user Shifts and uses Roar.  Targets hit by Roar immediately Shift away from the target using their highest usable movement capability, and towards their Trainer if possible. If the target is an owned Pokémon and ends this shift within 6 meters of their Poké Ball, they are immediately recalled to their Poké Ball. If that Trainer sends out a replacement, they do not lose their Pokémon turn.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Fire-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Fire-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: All foes within 3 meters are Suppressed for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Speed is raised 1 Combat Stage at the end of each of its turns. Speed Boost has no effect while out of combat.
